transcript: what is the return policy for electronics
response:
Sure! Here’s how returns work for electronics and accessories on ZentroMart:

* **Return window** – You have **7 calendar days from the delivery date** to return an electronic item. (If the item was delivered **before 1 August 2026**, the older policy gave a 10‑day window.)【RET-2】【RET-3】

* **Condition required** – The product must be **unused**, with its original tags, packaging, accessories and any free gifts. It must not be physically damaged, and any screen lock or account lock must be removed before you send it back【RET-4】.

* **Scope** – This applies to any electronics bought on ZentroMart, whether shipped by ZentroMart or a marketplace seller【RET-1】.

* **Return process** – A reverse‑pickup is arranged from your delivery address. There is **no return‑fee for electronics** (the ₹49 fee only applies to clothing, footwear and bags)【RET-6】.

* **After pickup** – The item goes through a quality check, and the refund is started within 2 business days (or at pickup for ZentroMart Plus members)【RET-7】.

If you need help arranging a return, just let me know!

retrieved_evidence.text:
## [RET-3] Change to electronics returns
From **1 August 2026**, the return window for electronics and accessories is 7 days. Electronics **delivered before 1 August 2026** keep the earlier 10-day window from version 3 of this policy.

retrieved_evidence.title: Condition of returned items
retrieved_evidence.text:
## [RET-4] Condition of returned items
Items must be unused, with original tags, packaging, accessories and free gifts. Beauty and personal care products are returnable only if unopened with the seal intact. Electronics must not be physically damaged, and any screen lock or account lock must be removed.

retrieved_evidence.title: Can I return something I bought?
retrieved_evidence.text:
## [FAQ-2] Can I return something I bought?
Most items can be returned within the return window. Some items, like grocery, cannot be returned.

retrieved_evidence.title: Items that cannot be returned
retrieved_evidence.text:
## [RET-5] Items that cannot be returned
Grocery and fresh produce, innerwear, lingerie and swimwear, and gift cards or digital codes cannot be returned for change of mind. If such an item arrives damaged, expired, wrong or missing, follow the Damaged, wrong or missing items policy.

retrieved_evidence.title: Scope
retrieved_evidence.text:
## [RET-1] Scope
This policy covers items bought on ZentroMart, whether shipped by ZentroMart or by a marketplace seller. Seller-specific warranty terms are in the Marketplace sellers policy, but return windows are the same for every seller.
